Hakke woote ina hoolnii jiyaaɓe fof potɗe ina mbaawi naatde e suɓaaɗe. Hakkeeji ɗii ina potta e jiyaaɓe fof, tawa ɓeyngu, diine, debbo walla gorko, walla ɗo iwi fof ɓennaani.

Leyɗeele keewɗe reentaaki hakkeeji tiiɗɗi ɗii, ɗum waɗi ɗi ɓuri tedduude e Amerik. Ndeenka-leydi ina hoolnii hakkeeji ɗii, kono jiyaaɓe ina poti wona yeewtotooɓe ngam reende ɗi. Ñaawirde Toowerde nde ina firta ko hakkeeji ɗii njiɗi wiyde e jamanu hannde. E nder taariika fof, Amerikankooɓe kaɓii ngam yaajnude hakkeeji ɗii e jiyaaɓe fof.

strings.Amendments are formal changes to the Con:
Waylitaaje ko bayle laawɗinaaɗe e Ndeenka-leydi, ina ɗaɓɓi jaɓeede e tataɓe ɗiɗi Kongres e jaɓeede e nayaɓe tati leyɗeele ɗee. Ndeenka-leydi waylitaama laabi 27, ɗum hollii no ndi waawrata yahdude e jamanuuji tawa ina hiisa daɗɗe mum.

Deftere Hakkeeji (waylitaaje 10 adiiɗe) ina reena ndimaaguuji tiiɗɗi. Waylitaare 13ɓere ndee momtii njiyaagu e 1865. Waylitaare 14ɓere, jaɓaande caggal Haare Hoɗɓe Leydi, ina hoolnii reentaari fotnduuri e laawol potngol. Waylitaare 15ɓere haɗii sendugol e woote ngam ɓeyngu. Waylitaare 19ɓere hokkii rewɓe hakke woote e 1920. Waylitaare 26ɓere jippinii duuɓi woote haa 18 e 1971.

Waylitaaje ina mbaawi kadi yaajnude hakkeeji woote, waylude no laamu golloto, e jaabaade geɗe taariika. Laawol waylitaare juutngol ngol ina hoolnii bayle ɗee ina miijtee no feewi, ina njaɓee e leydi ndii fof.

strings.American culture is diverse, reflecting:
Pinal Amerik ko ceerndungal, ina hollira yimɓe heewɓe ummiiɓe e nder aduna fof. Won nafooje ɗe yimɓe heewɓe njiɗi no feewi, ko wayi no ndimaagu neɗɗo kala, demokaraasi, potal e firsaaji. Amerik'en ina teddina ndimaagu haala, diina e miijo. Golle tiiɗɗe e ɓamtaare ina teddinee no feewi. Miijo 'Ƴeewndo Amerik'—wonde kala neɗɗo ina waawi yettaade sabu golle tiiɗɗe—ko ko woni hakkunde innde Amerik.

Pinal Amerik ina waawi gimi, naalankaagal, binndanɗe e filmuuji ɗi mbayliti aduna. Jazz, rock and roll e hip-hop ummorii ka Amerik. Hollywood waɗii filmuuji ɗi aduna fof ndaarata. Binndanɗe Amerik ina njogii binndooɓe lollirɓe ko wayi no Mark Twain e Ernest Hemingway. Ñaameele Amerik ina hollira semmbe eggooɓe ceertuɓe, ko wayi no ñaameele Itali, Siin, Meksik e goɗɗe keewɗe.

Mawlude ko wayi no Ñalnde Jeytaare (4 Suliyee), Thanksgiving e Memorial Day ina teddina nafooje e taariindi Amerik. Ceertugol pinal Amerik ina waɗa ngal wonde ngal ina yaha yeeso, ina waylitoo sahaa kala. Amerik'en ina teddina ceertuɗe maɓɓe tuma ɓe gollata ngam nafooje ɗe ɓe renndi. Faamde pinal Amerik ina wallita faamde taariindi leydi ndii e renndo hannde.
strings.American independence began with growing:
Jeytaare Amerik fuɗɗorii e haɓe ɓeydotooɗe hakkunde koloñiiji Britaañ sappo e tati ɗii e laamu Britaañ e gasirde duuɓi 1700. Koloñ'en ngoni no ɓe yoɓintinee lempo e nder laaɓal ko aldaa e ɓe ngonaa ka Parlemaa, ɗum addani konngol lollungol 'alaa lempo ko aldaa e jaŋtorde.' Kewuuji mawɗi addunooɗi jeytaare ina njogii Boston Tea Party e hitaande 1773, ɗo koloñ'en kalhi ataaye Britaañ e nder Boston Harbor ngam haɓde lempo.

Ñalnde 4 Suliyee 1776, Continental Congress ka Philadelphia jaɓii Bayyinal Jeytaare, ɗe Thomas Jefferson winndi ko ɓuri heewde. Ndee kaayit bayyinii seŋtugol koloñiiji ɗii e Britaañ, holliti kadi hakkeeji tuugnorɗi ɗi 'ngurndam, ndimaagu e ɗaɓɓitde weltaare.' Konu Fiyannde ndun tabitii gila 1775 haa 1783, Jeneraal George Washington ardii Konu Continental.

Hare mawɗe ina njogii Lexington e Concord e hitaande 1775 e Yorktown e hitaande 1781. Farayse rokkii Amerik'en ballal mawngal. Ahodal Paris e hitaande 1783 jaɓii jeytaare Amerik e laawol laamu. Konu ndun tabitinii Dowlaaji Dentuɗi ko leydi hesere jokkondirnde e demokaraasi e hakkeeji neɗɗo kala.

strings.Due process is the right to fair treatme:
Laawol ñaawoore poti ko hakke heɓde huutoraade no feewi e nder doosɗe sariya. Tippudi Leydi ndin hollirii wonde laamu waawaa ƴettude ngurndam, ndimaagu, walla jawdi neɗɗo tawa rewaani laawol ñaawoore poti. Ɗum firti ko rewde kuutorɗe e doosɗe sariya ɗe tabitinaa. Reeneeji laawol ñaawoore poti ɗin no tabitina wonde neɗɗo nanngetaake tawa sabaabu alaa walla lepetee tawa ñaawoore feewnde waɗaaka.

Laawol ñaawoore poti e bone ina wondi e hakke anndude tuumaaji ɗin, hakke heɓde awokaa, hakke ñaawoore feewnde, e reenaade seedanaade hoore mum. Waylaare Njoweteere (Fifth Amendment) ina wiya alaa neɗɗo ittetee ngurndam, ndimaagu, walla jawdi tawa rewaani laawol ñaawoore poti. Waylaare Njeegoɓere (Sixth Amendment) ina tabitina hakke ñaawoore feewnde e yaawnde e awokaa.

Laaɓugol haa tabitina bone ko kuule mawɗe. Ko laamu fotani tabitinde bone ɗon tawa sikke alaa. Yimɓe ina njogii hakke haɓaade seedeeji ɗi ngaddanaa ɗi e heɓde awokaa haɓanoowo ɓe. Ɗeen reeneeji ina njaaɓi hay yimɓe tuumaaɓe bonɗe mawɗe. Doosɗe ɗee timmaani, kono ɗeen kuutorɗe ina mballa haɗde yimɓe laaɓuɓe lepteede tawa ɓe ngonaani bonɓe.

Ko neeɓi hade Orop'en arde, Amerik'en Asliyankooɓe ngonnoo ko e Amerik Rewo e nder duuɓi ujunaaje, ɓe mahi ɓamtaare, pinal e laamuuji keewɗi. Ɓe ngoodnoo sariyaaji, laabi njulaagu e renndooji maɓɓe. Nde Orop'en ngarnoo e sakkitorde duuɓi 1400, ɓe ngonnoo ko e ɗaɓɓude laabi njulaagu kesi e jawdi.

Koloñaagu Orop'en addani Amerik'en Asliyankooɓe lorlaare mawnde. Ñabbuuji iwruɗi Orop mbari Amerik'en Asliyankooɓe miliyoŋaaji ɓe alaa reentaare. Orop'en ɓamii leyɗe Amerik'en Asliyankooɓe, ɓe ndoolni ɓe e nokkuuji famɗuɗi ɗi noddetee reservations. Amerik'en Asliyankooɓe ina ndaarnoo ko no ɓe ɓuri lesde, ɓe alaa hakkeeji sariya keewɗi. Ko heewi e maɓɓe ndoolnaa accude ɗemɗe maɓɓe, diine maɓɓe e pinal maɓɓe.

Hay e ndeen caɗeele, pinal Amerik'en Asliyankooɓe hisii, ina jokki haa hannde. Ina woodi lenyi 574 ɗi laamu federaal jaɓi e nder Dowlaaji Dentuɗi. Amerik'en Asliyankooɓe kaɓii ngam nuunɗal e jaɓeede. Sariya Indian Removal Act hitaande 1830 doolni Amerik'en Asliyankooɓe ujunaaje yahude hirnaange e Trail of Tears mbarooje. Hannde, Amerik'en Asliyankooɓe ina ndawroo ndimaagu laamu, hisnude pinal, e nuunɗal ngam tooñeeji taariika.

strings.Manifest Destiny was the belief that Ame:
Manifest Destiny ko gomɗinal wonde yaajugol Amerik e nder leydi ndii fof ko ko hatojinaa e ko laaɓi. Iwde e duuɓi 1800, Amerikaaɓe njahii hirnaange ina njiyla leyɗe, fartaŋŋe, e ngalu. Ngol yaajugol addani Amerikaaɓe Aranɓe (Native Americans) battane mawɗe, ngol mbayli kadi taarorde leydi ndii.

Soodugol Louisiana e hitaande 1803 ɓeydi mawnugol Dowlaaji Dentuɗi laabi ɗiɗi. Leydi Oregon heɓaa ko e kawrital e Angalteer. Hare Meksik e Amerik (1846-1848) addani Dowlaaji Dentuɗi heɓde Fommbina-hirnaange e California. Ndaɓɓitgol Kanyeeri California e hitaande 1849 addii ujunnaaje jooɗotooɓe hirnaange ina njiyla ngalu.

Yaajugol hirnaange addii haɓre hakkunde jooɗotooɓe e Amerikaaɓe Aranɓe, ɗum addi hareeji e eggingol doole. Sariya Homestead e hitaande 1862 rokki jooɗotooɓe leyɗe ɗe ɓe njoɓaali, so ɓe hoɗii ɗoon ɓe ndemii ɗum. Laabi laana njoorndi mahaa e nder leydi ndii fof, ina njokkondiri Fuɗnaange e Hirnaange. Nder hitaande 1890, keerol ngol jaabaa ko omboraa nde jooɗnde yottii Pasifik. Ngol yaajugol waɗii Dowlaaji Dentuɗi doole mawɗe e nder leydi ndii, kono ɗum wondi e coggu mawngu e dow Amerikaaɓe Aranɓe.

strings.State governments follow a similar struc:
Laamuuji leyɗe ɗee ina njokki doosgal nanndungal e laamu federaal: ina ngoodi senngo gardiiɗo (executive), senngo sosoowo sariyaaji (legislative), e senngo ñaawoore (judicial). Kala leydi ina jogii Gornoor (gardiiɗo), batu sosoowo sariyaaji leydi, e ñaawirde leydi (ñaawoore). Laamuuji leyɗe ɗee ina njiylo geɗe wano jaŋde, kisal yimɓe, dawrugol, e ballal renndo nder keeri mum.

Laamuuji nokku ina mbaɗi laamuuji konte, ca'e, e gure. Meer ko kanko ardata laamu saare, tuma nde komiseer'en walla ƴeewooɓe ndonkata laamuuji konte. Laamuuji nokku ina ndokka carwi wano poliis, sapoor-pompiyee, ndiyam, laawol ñoolɗi, e laabi. Ko heewi e ñaawooje ɓeyditooje nguurndam ñalnde kala ina ƴettee e tolno nokku.

Jokkondiral hakkunde laamu federaal, laamuuji leyɗe e laamuuji nokku ko Ndeenka Laamu (Constitution) e sariyaaji federaal tabitini ɗum. Leyɗe ɗee mbaawaa luukondirde e sariya federaal, kono ina njogii ndimaagu ardaade e geɗe ɗe laamu federaal tottaaka. Wonɓe-leydi ina kawra e tolnooji laamu fof e nder woote e jokkondiral renndo. Laamuuji nokku ko ɗuum ɓuri heewde ɓadaade wonɓe-leydi, ina njogii golle mawɗe e demokaraasi Amerik.

strings.The Bill of Rights protects ten fundamen:
Deftere Hakkeeji (Bill of Rights) ina reena ndimaaɗe sappo tuugnorɗe ɗe demokaraasi Amerik waawaa ɓadaade. Ɓeydaari Adiiri ndii ina hokka ndimaagu haala, diine, jaaynde, mottondiral, e naamnaago laamu. Ndimaaɗe ɗee ina newnana Amerikennaaɓe hollirde miijooji mum'en e jeyaade e golle demokaraasi.

Ɓeydaari Ɗimmiri ndii ina reena hakke jogaade kaɓirɗe. Ɓeydaari Tataɓiri ndii ina haɗa jippinde konuuɓe e galleeji. Ɓeydaari Nayaɓiri ndii ina reena yimɓe e ƴeewte e jaɓɓe ɗe njoɓaani. Ɓeydaari Joyaɓiri ndii ina hokka hakkeeji laawol sariya, ina haɗa neɗɗo seedantaade hoore mum. Ɓeydaari Jeegaɓiri ndii ina hokka hakke ñaawoore feewunde.

Ɓeydaari Jeeɗiɗaɓiri ndii ina hokka ñaawoore e juuri (jury) e ñaawooje siwil, Ɓeydaari Jeetati ndii ina haɗa lepte ñangle e ɗe njaltaani e ko woowaa. Ɓeydaari Jeenayaɓiri ndii ina reena hakkeeji ɗi limtaaka sakkitii, Ɓeydaari Sappoɓiri ndii ina hisna baawɗe ngam dowlaaji walla yimɓe. Hakkeeji ɗii ina fota e kala jeyaaɓe leydi, ɓe mbaawaa ittaade ɗi so wonaa e laawol sariya.

strings.The Civil War (1861-1865) was fought bet:
Wolde Nder Leydi (1861-1865) kaɓaa hakkunde Dental (Union, Rewo) e Konfederaasiyoŋ (Confederacy, Worgo). Sabaabu mawngu ngu ko luural e jiyaagal. Dowlaaji Worgo ina tuugnii e jiyaagal e faggudu mum'en, tawa dowlaaji Rewo ina njahra e golle ndimɓe. Nde Abraham Lincoln suɓaa Hooreejo e hitaande 1860, dowlaaji Worgo ceertii e Dental ngal.

Hooreejo Lincoln ardii Rewo e wolde ngam reende Dental ngal e haɗde jiyaagal. Anndinannde Ndimɗinal (Emancipation Proclamation) e hitaande 1863 anndini wonde maccuɓe ngonɓe e dowlaaji Konfederaasiyoŋ ko ndimɓe, kono ɗum huutoraaka fof haa Rewo foolti wolde ndee. Ɓeydaari 13ɓiri ndii momti jiyaagal e Dowlaaji Dentuɗi fof e hitaande 1865.

Wolde Nder Leydi warii ko ɓuri konuuɓe 600,000, ndee woni wolde ɓurnde warde yimɓe e taariika Amerik. Jeneraal Ulysses S. Grant ardii konuuji Dental haa poolgu. Caggal wolde ndee, peeje Mahtitaare (Reconstruction) mballi maccuɓe ɓooyɓe heɓde baawɗe politik e jaŋde. Ɓeydaari 14ɓiri e 15ɓiri ɗii kokki deenal fotngal e hakke woote, tawa leñol fawaaka. Bayle ɗee mbayli renndo Amerik e tuugnorɗe mum.

strings.The Industrial Revolution transformed Am:
Fiitaare Inndustiri (Industrial Revolution) waylii Amerik gila e renndo ngesooɓe ladde haa e leydi inndustiri gure mawɗe. Isiniiji, laabi ndaaɓdi e karallaagal kesal tagi ngalu mawngu e paltooji. Miliyoŋaaji eggiiɓe ngarii Amerik ngam yiylude golle e ngurndam ɓurngam moƴƴude. Gure mawɗe mawni yaawde nde yimɓe njiltunoo e ngesaaji ngarta e isiniiji.

Inndustiri addii caɗeele renndo kese, hono nokkuuji golle bonɗi, golle sukaaɓe, e baasal gure mawɗe. Gollotooɓe fuɗɗii fedde e sendikaaji ngam ɗaɓɓude njoɓdi, waktuuji e nokkuuji golle ɓurɗi moƴƴude. Jamaanu Ɓantaare (Progressive Era) (1890s-1920s) addii feewnitte, hono sariyaaji kisal e nokkuuji golle, doosɗe kisal ñaamdu, e sariyaaji haɗooji jeyeede njulaagu e jungo gooto (monopolies).

Karallaagal yawtii yaawde e feññingol cuurki (kuura), oto e laaɗe diwooje. Ɗeen kesuɗi mbaylii ngurndam ñalnde kala e njulaagu. Dowlaaji Dentuɗi ngonti doole inndustiri, caggal ɗuum doole mawɗe aduna. E nder teemedannde 20ɓiinde, Amerik wonti hakkunde kesuɗi, pinal e ngalu. Ɓantaare inndustiri moƴƴinii ngurndam Amerikeeɓe heewɓe, kono ñiŋal potal e caɗeele renndo ina keddii.

strings.The Judicial Branch consists of federal:
Fedde Ñaawoore (Judicial Branch) ina waɗi ñaawirɗe federaal ardiiɗe ko Ñaawirdu Toowndu Dowlaaji Dentuɗi Amerik. Ñaawirdu Toowndu ndu ina jogii ñaawooɓe jeenay, e nder mum'en Hooreejo Ñaawooɓe (Chief Justice). Ñaawooɓe ina toɗɗee ko Hooreejo Leydi, Senaa teeŋtina ɓe. Ñaawooɓe federaal ina ngoni e golle mum'en ngurndam maɓɓe fof, ɗum ina hokka ɓe jeytaare e ɗowgol politik.

Ñaawirdu Toowndu ko ñaawirdu ɓurndu toowde e nder leydi ndii, ndu jogii baawɗe ƴeewndo ñaawoore (judicial review)—baawde wiyde sariya ina luuɓondiri e Dustuur oo. Ñaawirɗe federaal lesɗe ina ñaawa ñaawooje ceertuɗe, kadi ina woodi ñaawirɗe diiwanuuji. Ñaawirɗe ɗee ina ndeenta no peewal huutoraa e nuunɗal, Dustuur oo kadi ina toppitee.

Ñaawirdu Toowndu ina heedoo ñaawooje jowitiiɗe e naamne Dustuur walla luure hakkunde diiwanuuji. Ñaawooɓe ina mbinnda miijooji firooji ñaawooje mum'en, ɗi ngonata ɓilgaaji sariya. Ñaawirdu ndu ina fotndina hakkeeji neɗɗo e baawɗe laamu. Ñaawooɓe jeenay ina njiɗi kawrude e ñaawooje, ɗum ina ɓeyda miijo hoyfuɗo. Fedde ñaawoore ina reena Amerikeeɓe e sariyaaji ɗi ngonaa peewal, ina hollita kadi reeno potngo les sariya.

strings.The President is the head of the Executi:
Hooreejo Leydi ko hooreejo Banngal Gollingal ngal, ina golla kadi hono hooreejo mawɗo konuuji leydi. Hooreejo Leydi ina suɓee ngam manndaaji duuɓi nay, ina waawi golla manndaaji ɗiɗi tan sabu Ɓeydital 22ɓal. Hooreejo Leydi ina waɗa sariyaaji federaal ɗi ndewee, ina toɗɗa ñaawooɓe federaal e terɗe Cabinet, ina haaldoo ngam ammaanaaji, ina hollita Kongres ñamri federaal.

Cabinet Hooreejo Leydi ina waɗi hooreeɓe ministeriiji ɓe ngi'ataa Hooreejo Leydi, ɓe njiilowa geɗe laamu ɗe njaltii, hono kisal leydi, geɗe leyɗe janane, kaalis, e geɗe nder leydi. Biro Gollingo Hooreejo Leydi ina waɗi golloowooɓe Suudu Ndaneeru e ɓe ngi'ataa ɓe mballata e golle ñalnde kala e cuɓe politik.

Hooreejo Leydi ina waawi veto sariyaaji ɗi Kongres jaɓi, kono Kongres ina waawi firtude ngal veto e woote sappo e njeenay e tati e nder sappo e njeenay (ɗiɗi e nder tati). strings.The U.S. Constitution was created in 178:
Tippudi Leydi U.S. sosaa ko e hitaande 1787 ka Kawral Tippudi Leydi (Constitutional Convention) e Philadelphia. Delege'en capanɗe njoy e njoy iwɗo e leyɗe (states) sappo e ɗiɗi ndenndii ngam windude ɓataake ɗo laamu Amerik tabitinta. Tippudi Leydi ndii lomtii Articles of Confederation, ɗi ɓannginoo ko ɗi lohi no feewi ngam ardaade leydi hesere ndii.

Baabiraaɓe Sosɗo Leydi mawɗo ina njeyaa e mum'en George Washington, James Madison, Benjamin Franklin, e James Wilson. Madison ina wiyee ko heewi « Baaba Tippudi Leydi » sabu o waroyii e eɓɓaaje ɓeydiiɗe ngam mbaadi laamu. Franklin, e duuɓi 81, ko kanko ɓuri mawnude e delege'en, o rokki faamu e jaɓondiral e nder kawral ngal fof.

Tippudi Leydi tabitinii pecce laamu tati e feere ndeenndaago e fotondiral (checks and balances). Ina reenii kadi hakkeeji neɗɗo kala e Bill of Rights, ɓeydaaɗo e hitaande 1791. Tippudi Leydi ɓeydaama laabi 27, ina wonii sariya ɓurɗo toowde e leydi ndii. Leyɗe (states) njaɓii mo e hitaande 1788, o fuɗɗii golle e hitaande 1789.

strings.The United States has many powerful symb:
Leyɗe Dentuɗe ina njogii maandeeji semmbiɗinɗi keewɗi holliraaɗi gollalji mum, taariika mum e miijooji mum. Darapo Amerik ina jogii ceeli sappo e tati holliraaɗi koloñeeji aranɗi ɗii e koode holliraaɗe leydi kala. Boɗeejum hollirta cuusal e tiiɗnaare, daneejum hollirta laaɓal e senaare, bulaajum hollirta reentaare, munyal e nuunɗal.

Ciilal Kooɓal (Bald Eagle), colel ngenndi amen, hollirta doole, cuusal e ndimaagu. Maandeeje Mawɗe (Great Seal) ina jogii ciilal ŋakki cate leggal oliwiye e kurul, holliraaɗi jam e reenaade. Mbaydi Ndimaagu (Statue of Liberty), nde Farayse okki e hitaande 1886, ina darii e Maayo New York ina jaɓɓa eggiiɓe ina hollira ndimaagu e firsaaji.

Jawgal Ndimaagu (Liberty Bell), ngal woni to Philadelphia, hollirta jeytaare e ndimaagu Amerik. Gimol Ngenndi, 'The Star-Spangled Banner,' winndaaɗo e hitaande 1814, ina fiyee hade golleeji ngenndi. Ɗee maandeeji ina kawrita Amerikeeɓe, ina siftina en gollalji ɗi en kawri. Duɗe ina kolla darapo ina njanga Fodoore Jokkondiral (Pledge of Allegiance). Amerikeeɓe ina njiɗi ɗee maandeeji no holliraaɗi leydi maɓɓe e miijooji mayri.
strings.The United States has many spectacular n:
Leyɗe Dentuɗe ina njogii nokkuuji tagoore haawniiɗi keewɗi holliraaɗi seertaagu leydi mum. Grand Canyon to Arizona ko woote e mbaydiiji leydi haawniiɗi ɓurɗi e aduna. Niagara Falls e keerol Kanadaa ko caangol semmbiɗingol. Yellowstone to Wyoming ko ngol aranol e jardinaaji ngenndi, ina jogii geyseeji e ɓulli tunduɗi.

Weendu Mawɗe (Great Lakes) ko yonde weenduuji ndiyam ɗannaaɗam ɓurndi mawnude e aduna. Tulde Rocky ina njaltii e leyɗe hirnaange. Maayo Mississippi ko maayo ɓurngo juutde e leydi ndii, ngo ina hatojini e taariika e njuɓɓudi Amerik. Tulde Appalachian ina njokkii e fuɗnaange Leyɗe Dentuɗe. Jardinaa Ngenndi Yosemite to Kaliforni ina jogii kaaƴe granit e caangle.

Jardinaaji ngenndi ñiɓnaa ngam reenude ndonu tagoore Amerik ngam tiiɗnaaɓe garooɓe. National Park Service ina toppitoo ɗee nokkuuji reenaaɗi. Milliyonaaji Amerikeeɓe ina njillotoo jardinaaji hitaande kala ngam weltaare, jaŋde e cuɓu tagoore. Jardinaaji ina mballa reende kulle ladde e ndaartagol ganndal. Nokkuuji tagoore ko iwdi mawninkinaare ngenndi e jokkondiral e leydi. Reende ɗee nokkuuji ina yeewee no fawaade e tiiɗnaaɓe garooɓe.
strings.The United States is a democratic republ:
Leyɗe Dentuɗe ko repibilik demokaraasi, maana ko doole ɗee ko e juuɗe yimɓe ɓe cuɓata surɗe ngam laamaade. Demokaraasi ina tuugii e laawol wonde yimɓe fof ina potti, kala e mum ina jogii haala e ñaawooji laamu.

Yonde federaal ina feccita doole hakkunde laamu ngenndi e laamuuji leyɗe. Ɗum ina haɗa laamu gooto waawde heɓde doole ɓurɗe. Laamu ngenndi ina toppitoo geɗe jeyaaɗe e leydi ndii fof, ndeen leyɗe ina toppitoo geɗe nokku. Ndee yonde ina hokka kawral e seertaagu e leydi ndii fof.

Demokaraasi Amerik ina tuugii e cuɓooji rimɗi e nuunɗuɗi, ndimaagu jaayndeeji, feccere doole e reende hakkeeji neɗɗo kala. Wonɓe e leydi ina kawra e ndeen fii woote, golleede e jury, e huutoraade e golle ngenndi. Demokaraasi cellundi ina sokli wonɓe e leydi humpitiiɓe ɓe faami hakkeeji maɓɓe e sasiiji maɓɓe. Doosgal ngal ina reena ɗee laabi demokaraasi, waawaa waylteede si wonaa e laawol juutngol.

Caltol Sariya (Legislative) ina waawi ɓaŋde veto Persidaa, salaade jaɓde budse Persidaa, e ittude Persidaa rewrude e tuumaade (impeachment). Senaa ina tabitina ñaawooɓe e jaagorɗe ɗe Persidaa toɗɗi.

Caltol Gardiigu (Executive, Persidaa) ina waawi salaade (veto) sariyaaji ɗi Kongres jaɓi, ina toɗɗa ñaawooɓe e jaagorɗe. Persidaa ina gollina sariyaaji ɗi Kongres waɗi. Caltol Ñaawoore (Judicial) ina waawi wiyde sariyaaji ina luulndi Doosgal ngal, e firde no sariyaaji gollirta. Senaa ina foti tabitinde toɗɗaaɓe ñaawoore, Kongres kadi ina waawi tellinde ɓeydaneeje ngam firtude ñaawooje Ñaawirdu Toowndu (Supreme Court).

Siistem ngoo ina haɗa baawɗe moofteede e juuɗe gootal, ina reena hakkeeji jeyaaɓe leydi. Baabiraaɓe Fuɗɗorɓe (Founding Fathers) ina mbaɗi laamu ngu kala caltol dakkondirta e peƴƴondira e goɗɗe ɗee e anniyaaji. Misaalaaji ƴeewndoo e peƴƴondiral e golle ko Kongres ɓaŋde veto persidaa, Ñaawirdu Toowndu wiyde sariya ina luulndi Doosgal, walla Senaa salaade toɗɗaaɗo persidaa. Mbaydi ndii ina dari laamu Amerik ko ɓuri duuɓi 230.

strings.Voting is a fundamental right in America:
Woote ko hakke ɗaɓɓunde e demokaraasi Amerik, kono wonaano ko heɓoraaɗo neɗɗo fof sahaa kala. Ko adii, ko worɓe daneeɓe jogiiɓe jawdi tan waawnoo wootaade. E nder sahaa, hakkeeji woote yaajnaama baylitte (amendments) e sariyaaji.

Baylitol 15ɓol (1870) haɗii seŋnge e woote e dow asli. Baylitol 19ɓol (1920) hokkii rewɓe hakke wootaade. Sariya Hakkeeji Woote (Voting Rights Act) 1965 momtii jarribanɗe janngude e winndude e luure goɗɗe huutoranooɗe ngam haɗde Afriknaaɓe Amerik wootaade. Baylitol 26ɓol (1971) jattinii duuɓi woote haa 18.

Hannde, ɓiɓɓe leydi U.S. ɓe duuɓi mum'en ina njooɓi 18 e ɓe kaɓɓii ɗaɓɓe hoɗorde ina mbaawi wootaade. Woote ina waɗee e suɓaaɗe ɗe ɓiɓɓe leydi suɓortoo nawliiɓe e hooreeɓe. Suɓaaɗe ɗe ngonata sahaa kala ina kisna laamu ina jaabtoo yimɓe ɓe. Woote adiiɗo e kayitaaji woote nelaaɗi e posto ina newnana ɓiɓɓe leydi naatde e demokaraasi.

strings.With rights come responsibilities. Citiz:
Hakkeeji ina ngarda e ndimaagu. Ɓiɓɓe leydi ina njogii ndimaagu jokkude sariyaaji ɗi poti e yimɓe fof. Yoɓde lampooji ina yoɓa golle laamu ɗii wano duɗe, laawi, reenaade leydi, e porogaraamuuji ballal. Jooɗaade e jurii tuma ngewnaa ina hokka hoolaare nde ñaawooje ngoni potɗe, nde ñaawoore wonata e juuɗe mofte nanndooɓe.

Ɓiɓɓe leydi ina poti woote e cuɓooji ngam daande maɓɓe nanee, hooreeɓe ɓee kadi mbona ɓe lamndetee. Jannginde hoore mum e kala ko faati e caɗeele e sukkundiiɓe ina walla ngam woote e anndal. Ɓiɓɓe leydi ina mbaawi golloyde e dartaaɗe e nder renndooji maɓɓe e naatde e fedde ngenndiyankeeje. Teddinde hakkeeji e jawdi woɗɓe ko huunde nde renndo gollirta.

Jibnaaɓe ina njogii ndimaagu janngingol ɓiɓɓe maɓɓe. Ɓiɓɓe leydi ina poti teddinde ndonnaandi ngam yimɓe garooɓe. Ko heewi ina ngoongɗini ɓiɓɓe leydi ina njogii kadi ndimaagu faamde Doosgal e hakkeeji maɓɓe. Ndimaaji ɗii ina mballa reende demokaraasi semmbiɗinndi reenoowo hakkeeji kala gooto. Tuma ɓiɓɓe leydi timminii ndimaaji ɗii, laamu ina ɓura gollirde no haani, renndooji kadi ina ɓeyda yaajde.
